description: This file defines multiple Grain classes related to transaction attribution in Orleans, including classes for different attribution behaviors and a static helper class for retrieving nested transaction IDs.

classes.name: NoAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class for no attribution behavior, delegates transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: SuppressAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class for suppressing attribution, delegates transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: CreateOrJoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class for creating or joining attribution, delegates transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: CreateAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class for creating attribution, delegates transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: JoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class for joining attribution, delegates transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: SupportedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class indicating supported attribution, delegates transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: NotAllowedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Grain class indicating attribution not allowed, delegates transaction ID retrieval to AttributionGrain.

classes.name: AttributionGrain
classes.description: Internal static class providing method to retrieve nested transaction IDs asynchronously.

methods.name: GetNestedTransactionIds
methods.description: Static method that recursively retrieves nested transaction IDs for a given tier and tiers list.
